review:
Group of friends that go for a weekend on an isolated house in the woods and things go sideways. From that description you can picture many movies, but what makes this one distinct it’s something that would spoil some of the surprises it has stored.

But the movie has more to offer than just those surprises. The acting of the main characters, interpreted by Jack Quaid and Sophie Thatcher, are really good and sell their chemistry well. The others’ acting also doesn’t fall behind.

With a well crafted plot and good acting, this short suspense thriller is fun watch that even let some thoughts for you to ponder after it ends.
